title: 第14章修魔系统
slug: 最强升级系统全本免费-最强升级系统最新章节列表
content_zh:
“恭喜玩家‘龙飞’击杀‘魔宗龙大耀’获得经验1000点，真气值100点，能量值10点。”
“恭喜玩家‘龙飞’获得玄阶九品‘幽冥魔焰功’是否修炼？”
“恭喜玩家‘龙飞’获得‘血海魔宗’令牌。”
“恭喜玩家‘龙飞’获得一千两银子。”
系统声音刚落。
龙飞有些郁闷，喃喃道：“就爆出这点东西吗？还不如一直蛤蟆爆的多啊，真是扫兴。”
他的话还没有说完。
系统提示音又响起。
“叮！”
“恭喜玩家‘龙飞’触发‘修魔系统’，是否开始魔修？”
“叮！”
“恭喜玩家‘龙飞’触发‘积分系统’”
“呃？”
“爆出两个‘系统’？”龙飞心头一惊，立即查看系统起来。
修魔系统。
玩家可以转换修炼之身，一天之内只能转换一次，每次转换需要一千点积分。
简而言之。
只要龙飞确认修炼‘修魔系统’之后，他能转化成修魔之人，当然要在有一千积分的前提下才能够完成转换。
魔修转换回来也需要一千点积分。
不过，魔身受伤，转换回来也同样是受伤。

魔身修为突破，转换回来，原来的身体等级也会突破，也就是等级，真气，功法，都是共享的。
除此之外，修魔也修魔的好处，修炼的魔功对一些宗门弟子的伤害会有加成作用，反之也是一样。
只有确认修魔之后才能修炼魔功。
“双修？”龙飞想都没想，意念一动，立刻确认道：“修炼！”
“叮！”
“恭喜玩家‘龙飞’开启‘修魔系统’获得经验值100点，真气值100点，积分值100点奖励。”
“以后在宗门面前我是正派人士，惩奸除恶，诛杀邪魔外道为己任。在魔宗面前，我是狂魔，专门杀那些伪君子，简直就是左右逢源，狂暴系统简直真的太爽了，哈哈哈……”龙飞心里笑个不停。
以后不管是在宗门，还是在魔宗，他都能风生水起。
更为关键的一点。
他能享有两个地方的修炼资源，这才是最为重要的。
龙飞查看‘积分系统’，不看不知道，一看……他当时就有点吓尿了。
积分系统。
描述：诛杀普通宗门弟子可获得10点积分，诛杀普通魔宗弟子可获得10点积分，实力越强，积分越多。
描述2：完成任务可获得积分奖励，积分随任务难度而定。
描述3：炼制出极品丹药，刻制出极品阵法，炼制出极品玄兵，收服极品妖兽……都可以获得积分奖励。
描述4：玩家不用的法宝，灵器，功法，战宠都可以兑换积分。
描述5：开启积分兑换，积分抽奖，只要你拥有足够的积分，你能兑换到一起你想要的东西。
“我的天啊！”
龙飞看着‘积分系统’完全震住了，“有了这个牛逼积分系统，老子不是要什么有什么吗？”
“等等！”

“我先看看都有哪些商品能兑换。”
龙飞…我靠，这边还有，招魂幡，玲珑宝塔，如来神掌，盘古分身……我擦，竟然还能兑换九天仙女为之战斗……”
“不行了！”
“我的心脏有点承受不住了。”龙飞的心跳直线加速，热血翻滚，已经快要承受不住了。
每一件东西都是好东西，对天武大陆而言，全都是神品级别的宝物。
太诱人了。
龙飞看了一眼兑换积分，整个人都二逼了，“龙血一份，兑换积分需要8000000点，大罗金丹……”
一串长长的‘零’，龙飞有些无力了。
“我去你大爷的，弄出来诱惑老子的是吧？”龙飞顿时浑身上下都不爽，就恨不得把系统拉出暴揍一顿。
每一件东西都是好东西，可是每一件东西所需要的积分都高的吓人。
这尼玛……太坑爹了！
开始还兴奋的不行，瞬间掉进冰窟窿一样，感觉人生都失去意义了。
好奇心之下。
龙飞暗道：“看看这把屠龙刀值多少积分。”
积分兑换系统，有兑，当然也有换，透过系统一看，龙飞嘴巴张成‘O’字形，回不过神来，数了足足十遍才数清楚那串长长的零，“竟然能兑换八千万积分，太牛逼了，如果把屠龙刀修复完成的话，那不是要破好几亿？”
“咕咚！”
龙飞重重的咽了一下口水，“突然就发现自己太牛逼了，哈哈哈……”

content_en:
"Congratulations to player 'Long Fei' for killing 'Demon Sect Long Dayao' and gaining 1,000 experience points, 100 Qi points, and 10 energy points."
"Congratulations to the player 'Long Fei' for obtaining the ninth-grade Xuan level 'Netherworld Demonic Flame Technique'. Do you want to practice it?"
"Congratulations to player 'Long Fei' for obtaining the 'Blood Sea Demon Sect' token."
"Congratulations to player 'Long Fei' for winning one thousand taels of silver."
The system sound just dropped.
Long Fei was a little depressed and murmured: "Is this the only thing that's going to explode? It's better to just explode more toads all the time. It's really disappointing."
He hasn't finished speaking yet.
The system prompt sounded again.
"Ding!"
"Congratulations to the player 'Long Fei' for triggering the 'Magic Cultivation System'. Do you want to start the magic cultivation?"
"Ding!"
“Congratulations to player ‘Long Fei’ for triggering the ‘Points System’”
"Huh?"
"Two 'systems' revealed?" Long Fei was shocked and immediately checked the system.
Magic repair system.
Players can convert their cultivation bodies, but they can only do so once a day. Each conversion requires one thousand points.
in short.
As long as Long Fei confirms that he has practiced the 'Demon Cultivation System', he can transform into a demon cultivator. Of course, he can only complete the transformation if he has one thousand points.
It also takes one thousand points to convert the magic cultivator back.
However, if the demon body is injured, the transformation back will also be injured.
When the demon body's cultivation level is broken through and converted back, the original body level will also be broken through, that is, the level, true energy, and skills are all shared.
In addition, cultivating demons also has the benefits of cultivating demons. The demonic skills you cultivate will have a bonus effect on the damage of some sect disciples, and vice versa.
Only after confirming the cultivation of demons can you practice demonic skills.
"Dual cultivation?" Long Fei didn't even think about it. He immediately confirmed: "Practice!"
"Ding!"
"Congratulations to the player 'Long Fei' for opening the 'Demon Cultivation System' and gaining 100 experience points, 100 Qi points, and 100 points as rewards."
"From now on, in front of the sect, I will be an upright person, punishing rape and eliminating evil, and killing evil spirits and heretics. In front of the demon sect, I will be a crazy demon, specializing in killing those hypocrites. I can have both sides, and the violent system is so exciting, hahaha..." Long Fei couldn't stop laughing in his heart.
In the future, whether he is in the sect or the Demon Sect, he will be able to prosper.
A more critical point.
He can enjoy the cultivation resources of two places, which is the most important thing.
Long Fei checked the 'Points System'. He didn't know if he didn't look at it. When he saw it... he was a little scared to pee.
Points system.
Description: You can get 10 points by killing ordinary sect disciples, and you can get 10 points by killing ordinary demon sect disciples. The stronger you are, the more points you get.
Description 2: Completing tasks can earn points as rewards. Points depend on the difficulty of the task.
Description 3: Refining the best elixirs, carving the best formations, refining the best mysterious weapons, subduing the best monsters... you can get points rewards.
Description 4: Players’ unused magic weapons, spiritual weapons, exercises, and battle pets can be redeemed for points.
Description 5: Enable points redemption and point lottery. As long as you have enough points, you can redeem what you want.
"Oh my God!"
Long Fei was completely shocked when he saw the 'point system', "With this awesome point system, don't I get everything I want?"
"Wait!"
"Let me see what products can be redeemed first."
Long Fei... Damn, here we have the Soul-Calling Flag, the Exquisite Pagoda, the Tathagata Divine Palm, Pangu's clone... Oh my God, I can actually exchange it for the Nine Heavens Fairy to fight for it..."
"No more! "
“My heart can’t take it anymore. "Long Fei's heartbeat accelerated, his blood boiled, and he could no longer bear it.
Every item is a good thing, and to Tianwu Continent, they are all divine level treasures.
So tempting.
Long Fei glanced at the redemption points and was stunned, "One share of dragon's blood, redemption pointsPoints need 8,000,000 points, Daluo Jindan..."
A long string of 'zeros', Long Fei felt a little weak.
"Fuck you, uncle, did you come up with something to tempt me? "Long Fei suddenly felt uncomfortable all over his body, and he wanted to pull out the system and beat him up.
Every item is a good item, but the points required for each item are terrifyingly high.
This damn thing... is so deceptive!
I was so excited at first, and it felt like I fell into an ice hole in an instant, and I felt like my life had lost all meaning.
Out of curiosity.
Long Fei secretly said: "Look how many points this dragon-slaying knife is worth. "
The points redemption system has redemption and of course exchange. Looking through the system, Long Fei opened his mouth in an 'O' shape and couldn't recover. He counted it ten times before he could count the long string of zeros. "It's amazing that you can redeem 80 million points. If the Dragon Saber is repaired, won't it cost hundreds of millions?" "
“Gudong! "
Long Fei swallowed hard, "Suddenly I realized that I was so awesome, hahaha..."
